core_obligations: Reduce to an integral base: the identity of bivariant classes is checked after capping with the fundamental class of an integral X (proof lines 7989-7991).

Set up the induction on the rank of the submodule: the case of rank one is the rank one additivity statement, and for larger rank one pulls back to the projective bundle of the submodule, where the pullback of the submodule sits in a short exact sequence with an invertible quotient and the pullback of Chow groups is injective (proof lines 7992-8004).

Finish the induction step: with the kernel of the displayed surjection from the pulled back module onto the quotient, the induction hypothesis applies to the two exact sequences, so the cap of the Chern class of the pulled back module with the fundamental class equals the cap of the product of the Chern classes of the pulled back submodule and of the pulled back quotient, and since the fundamental class of the projective bundle is the pullback of the class of the base, injectivity of pullback gives the identity (proof lines 8005-8018).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to an integral base (proof lines 7989-7991).
Induct on the rank of the submodule, using the projective bundle to split off an invertible quotient (proof lines 7992-8004).
Apply the induction hypothesis to the two exact sequences and descend by injectivity of pullback (proof lines 8005-8018).
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the multiplicativity of the total Chern class in a short exact sequence of finite locally free sheaves, c(E) = c(E_1) c(E_2) (statement lines 7964-7987, tag 02UI). The proof reduces to an integral base, then runs an induction on the rank of the submodule: it passes to the projective bundle of the submodule, where the pulled back submodule acquires an invertible quotient, applies the induction hypothesis to the two resulting exact sequences, and descends the resulting identity using injectivity of pullback along the bundle and the identification of the fundamental class of the bundle with the pullback of the class of the base. The induction with its passage to the projective bundle is the substance, so the claim is H2.
